hero.title: Namaste: Your Authentic South Indian Tiffin Cuisine Destination
hero.subtitle: Experience the authenticity of South India in every nutrient-rich dish.

about.title: Our Passion, Our Story, Our Heart
about.paragraph1: Born out of a deep passion for food, Namaste is your exclusive destination to relish authentic South Indian tiffin cuisines. Each dish is a delightful journey, embodying the rich flavors and nutrients of South India, a true pleasure for every food lover and discerning palate.
about.paragraph2: Beyond our culinary craft, Namaste is built on a foundation of community spirit. During the challenging COVID-19 lockdown, we transformed our operations to provide over 26,000 meals to migrant laborers in Bangalore, in association with Milaap and Sampark (NGO), helping sustain families during their toughest times. This commitment to nourishment extends both to our food and our community.
